summary: MKDWELL Tech Inc., a Taiwan-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an At The Market Offering Agreement with Maxim Group LLC as sales agent for an ATM program of up to $100,000,000 in ordinary shares. Sales occur at the company's discretion on Nasdaq under an existing Form F-3 shelf. Placement fees step down from 3.0% to 2.5% by proceeds tranche, plus up to $50,000 legal reimbursement and $5,000 quarterly diligence. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and Nasdaq minimum-price compliance.
